title: Filter Groups with HAVING
description: Find departments that have more than 5 employees using HAVING.

data.text: Write a query to find all departments with more than 5 employees.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT Department, COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount
FROM Employees
GROUP BY Department
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY EmployeeCount DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: WHERE filters rows before grouping; HAVING filters groups after GROUP BY. You cannot use WHERE with an aggregate like COUNT(*). HAVING is the correct place for aggregate conditions.
